archetypes.name: dyn-design-prose-ratchet
archetypes.rationale: Checks that SKILL.md compression preserved prompt contracts and the ratchet matches the final line count.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design SKILL.md whitespace compression and the new structure-test ratchet. Check that no contract-bearing literals, fenced commands, or step-control relationships changed despite the line-count reduction. Verify the documented ratchet threshold matches the final file line count and that the sibling docs describe the new guard without introducing drift-prone hardcoded prose. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
